Name: FashionMirrorCatalog
Author: Moux303
Description:
# FashionMirrorCatalog

FashionMirrorCatalog adds a visual wardrobe catalog to the Fashion Sense Hand Mirror, allowing you to browse your installed appearances by category and preview them directly on your farmer.

Instead of searching through appearance names one by one, you can simply browse the catalog and see what each hairstyle, clothing item, hat, accessory, or other appearance looks like on your character.

In short: turn your Fashion Sense Hand Mirror into a visual wardrobe.

# Main Features

## Visual browsing

The catalog supports the following Fashion Sense appearance types:

- Hair
- Accessories
- Hats
- Body
- Shirts
- Pants
- Sleeves
- Shoes

Each category displays appearances in a 3×3 grid, with 9 appearances per page.

## Character previews

Each appearance is displayed as a character preview rather than a generic item icon.

The preview uses your current farmer's appearance, Fashion Sense colors, and other equipped appearances. It also follows your farmer's current facing direction.

The currently equipped appearance is marked with a green dot.

Clicking an appearance will immediately equip it.

## Accessories

FashionMirrorCatalog supports all three Fashion Sense accessory slots.

The selected accessory slot stays synchronized with the original Fashion Sense Hand Mirror, allowing you to browse and equip accessories for slots 1, 2, and 3 directly from the catalog.

## Hand Mirror integration

FashionMirrorCatalog works alongside the original Fashion Sense Hand Mirror rather than replacing it.

The selected category is synchronized between the catalog and the original Hand Mirror. Changes made in either interface will be reflected in the other.

The original Hand Mirror remains usable outside the catalog panel.

## Pagination

The catalog displays 9 appearances per page in a 3×3 grid.

You can navigate between pages using the arrow buttons or the mouse wheel.

The catalog also displays the current page and the total number of appearances in the selected category.

# Installation

- Install the latest version of SMAPI.
- Install Fashion Sense 7.5.0 or later.
- Download FashionMirrorCatalog and extract it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
- Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

The mod will automatically detect Fashion Sense and integrate with its Hand Mirror.

# Requirements

- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.5.0 or later
- Fashion Sense 7.5.0 or later

FashionMirrorCatalog does not contain any appearance assets itself. It reads appearances provided by Fashion Sense and installed Fashion Sense content packs.

# Compatibility

FashionMirrorCatalog is designed to work with Fashion Sense appearance packs without requiring individual compatibility patches.

The catalog uses Stardew Valley's standard menu textures, so compatible UI reskins can also affect its appearance.

Current testing: Windows only. Version 0.1.0.
